messages:
ida: Heads-up: prod canary failed image verification in the admission controller. cosign verify returned 'key not found' and audit shows no signer.identity field. linking logs.

marc: ugh. did we rotate the cosign key yesterday? i saw a keystore change in the rotation PR.

ida: snippet from admission log:
```
2026-08-12T03:14:02Z admission-controller: verification failed: cosign: public key for keyID 'projects/keystore-prod/keys/cosign-1' not found
2026-08-12T03:14:02Z admission-controller: mutating-webhook dropped annotation "image.signature.cosign" due to policy:forbid-external-annotations
2026-08-12T03:14:02Z audit: signer.identity=""
```

jun: two things to check: 1) key rotation might have created a new key resource and removed the old key binding; 2) new mutating webhook policy (tighten-annotations) was deployed last night and may be stripping the cosign signature annotation before the verifier runs. that would explain missing signer identity in audit.

cosign-bot: Signature check failed for image gcr.io/redwood/api@sha256:abcd1234 -> reason: PublicKeyNotFound (key resource projects/keystore-prod/keys/cosign-1). See https://ci.internal/cosign/logs/verify/9072 :warning:

marc: i pulled the keystore audit: rotation PR created a new key cosign-2 and removed an IAM binding for serviceAccount:admission@infra.svc from cosign-1. PR note said "remove legacy access".

jun: if admission SA lost decrypt/verify access then cosign can't fetch the public key material (we store wrapped public key in KMS-backed secret). But the error says public key missing, not 403. Could be admission expects the annotation to include key path and webhook stripped it. order of operations matters.

ida: timeline: 01:00 deploy tightened webhook (forbid-external-annotations). 01:15 keystore rotation PR merged that removed SA binding to cosign-1. 03:14 canary runs and fails. seems both changes combined to break verification.

marc: mitigation: 1) rollback webhook change to allow the annotation to pass through for internal registries (fast), 2) re-add a narrow IAM binding for admission@infra.svc to the old key cosign-1 while we rotate images to cosign-2, 3) add explicit audit events when mutating-webhooks drop annotations.

jun: preference is avoid RBAC emergency if we can roll the webhook back quickly. re-allowing the annotation for gcr.io/* and quay.redwood/* is low risk and buys time.

oncall: INC-2610 opened: https://tickets.internal/INC-2610  oncall will coordinate rollback and customer comms.

ida: i'm going to trigger a canary with the webhook rollback (revert tighten-annotations). will report back in 5m.

cosign-bot: cosign verify retry queued for canary-9922.

marc: also putting a short-term patch into keystore: re-grant admission@infra.svc roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on cosign-1 at key-level so existing manifests keep verifying. command: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding cosign-1 \
  --location=global --keyring=signers --member=serviceAccount:admission@infra.svc \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer --project=keystore-prod
```
(note: publicKeyViewer is hypothetical; adapt to our key access model).

jun: good. after rollback let's run a quick manifest scan for images signed with cosign-1 and queue rebuilds to cosign-2. also add a CI lint that flags webhook and keystore changes in the same rollout window.

ida: canary re-run -> canary-9922 started. cosign verify shows success, admission attached signer.identity in audit: "cosign-2:thumbprint:7f3a".

sec-bot: vuln-scan: cosign-2 is using updated cosign binary 2.2.0 (no CVEs).

ida: rolling forward: We'll keep webhook permissive for 2 hours while we complete keystore fixes and image rebuilds. marc please post the IAM diff when done. jun please open CI guardrail PR. I'll update INC-2610 with status.

marc: IAM binding added to cosign-1 for admission@infra.svc. diff posted: https://git.internal/keystore/PR-498 :white_check_mark:

jun: CI guardrail PR opened: fail if keystore rotation and webhook tightening PRs land within 2 deploy windows of each other. link: https://git.internal/infra/PR-789

ida: postmortem TODOs: - add audit event "annotation_dropped_by_webhook" with reason and webhook name - add explicit signer_attach success/fail events with key id and pod info - runbook update: when rotating cosign keys, coordinate webhook policy changes and IAM in the same incident window.

oncall: closing INC-2610 after verification. oncall will open PT-209 postmortem ticket.

ida: thanks team. leaving thread for postmortem notes and links to rebuild queue.
